purpose: Replace the independently rejected v129 restarted-K1 shell with a physically distinct two-direction Krylov-state initializer that preserves the CGLS conjugate direction while retaining a strict 2A+2A^T deployment budget.
scientific_question: Can an unordered pose-conditioned camera-set model predict both the K3 solution dual and the K3-to-K4 conjugate-direction dual, so that an observable two-dimensional least-squares solve matches zero-start CGLS K4 across variable camera sets and factorized camera errors?
claim_boundary: This is post-open development on synthetic straight-ray BOS observations of public PoolFire CFD. Stage A is an observation-only exact-teacher capacity diagnostic. It is not a learned result, a fresh or external test, curved-ray evidence, experimental BOST evidence, resource speedup, broad generalization, an algorithm breakthrough, or paper success.

negative_parent_decision.mechanism_interpretation: The exact K3 solution dual followed by observable scaling and restarted CGLS K1 loses the fourth-step conjugate direction. Global candidate/K4 field and observation ratios have p90 1.08840 and 1.11253, while alpha is one to floating-point precision. v129 must not be trained or enlarged.

sealed_v129_dataset.reuse_rule: v130 may read the sealed v129 observation, pose, mask, K3 solution-dual and sample-roster bytes after verifying these bindings. It must regenerate the conjugate-direction dual and K4 reference from the reported geometry and observation.

data_contract.outer_evaluation: five leave-one-complete-trajectory-out folds after Stage A

dual_state_teacher.solution_dual_z3: the natural detector dual after the third zero-start CGLS update, satisfying A^T z3=x3
dual_state_teacher.direction_dual_e3: after the third residual update, compute s3=A^T r3, beta3=<s3,s3>/<s2,s2>, p3=s3+beta3 p2 and e3=r3+beta3 e2, satisfying A^T e3=p3
dual_state_teacher.reference: zero-start CGLS K4 from the identical noisy observation and reported geometry

observable_two_direction_shell.path: h=A^T z, p=A^T e, u=A h, v=A p, then solve min_{c0,c1} ||y-c0 u-c1 v||_2 over the frozen coefficient box and return x=c0 h+c1 p
observable_two_direction_shell.solver: deterministic exact two-variable box-constrained least squares: evaluate the unconstrained normal-equation solution when feasible, the analytic minimizer on each of four edges, and four corners; choose the lowest residual objective with lexicographic tie break
observable_two_direction_shell.degeneracy_rule: require positive column norms and a finite Gram matrix; edge/corner candidates keep the solve defined when the unconstrained Gram determinant is small
observable_two_direction_shell.stage_a_failure_action: Stop v130 before model fitting; do not alter the coefficient box, add directions or enlarge a network after seeing the result.

conditional_model.inputs: padded [B,12,2,16,16] noisy observations, [B,12,18] reported pose tokens and [B,12] mask
conditional_model.outputs: padded [B,12,2,2,16,16], with state index 0 for z and 1 for e
conditional_model.architecture: the v129 shared 2->8->12 camera encoder, 18->16->12 pose MLP, 24->16 camera embedding, masked mean/max DeepSets context and shared decoder, with four output channels and four learned odd skip gains
conditional_model.set_property: co-permuting observation, matching pose and mask must co-permute both dual-state outputs; padding stays exactly zero
conditional_model.scale_property: per-sample observation RMS normalization plus odd symmetrization, with both dual states restored to observation scale

conditional_training.outer_rule: five complete-trajectory leave-one-out folds; every preprocessing value and weight uses only the other four trajectories
conditional_training.loss: equal-weight mean of per-sample squared relative-L2 for z3 and e3 over active cameras

decision.if_stage_a_passes: Implement the 11504-parameter model, shared dual-state ridge and ablations; do not claim learning success yet.
decision.if_primary_model_fails: Close this representation without FNO, UNO or larger U-Net rescue.
decision.if_three_seeds_and_controls_pass: Call it opened-fit development headroom only and freeze one previously unopened public reaction-flow condition before any external claim.
decision.resource_gate: Fresh wall and whole-pipeline RSS remain forbidden before independently validated accuracy, replication and control gates pass.
decision.real_data_gate: Experimental transfer still requires displacement images, per-camera calibration and IDs, coordinate conventions, repeat-noise information and the laboratory-approved baseline.
